meta.title: Whizzzest — One encounter, ten thousand years endure
meta.description: Explore a thousand years of fireworks culture, living heritage, local flavors and the scenery of Wanzai. The home of Chinese fireworks · Jiangxi, China.

hero.title: One encounter, ten thousand years endure
hero.subtitle: A thousand years of fireworks, living heritage, distinctive flavors and the scenery of Wanzai

carousel.alt: One encounter, ten thousand years endure

features.title: A millennium of fireworks
features.desc: Wanzai has made fireworks for over 1,400 years — it is known as "the hometown of Chinese fireworks".

features.title: Distinctive local flavors
features.desc: Taste the Six Bowls of Wanzai, lily dishes and Luocheng rice noodles — the unique food culture of western Jiangxi.

features.title: Rich travel resources
features.desc: Wanzai Ancient City, Zhushan Cave, Jiulong primeval forest and more — something for every traveler.

themes.title: Discover Wanzai
themes.desc: Millennium fireworks, western-Jiangxi flavors, an ancient town by the water — three doors into Wanzai.

items.title: Living heritage
items.desc: Fireworks, Desheng Drum, Kaikou Nuo and Xiabu weaving — millennium-old traditions alive in the city's daily glow.

items.title: Local flavors
items.desc: The Six Bowls, Luocheng rice noodles, lily starch — Wanzai on the tip of your tongue.

items.title: Fireworks industry
items.desc: One of China's four major fireworks production regions — from family workshops to skies around the globe.

experience.title: Experience Wanzai
experience.desc: More than watching from behind a screen — launch your own fireworks and read stories by Wanzai writers.

items.title: Launch a Wanzai firework in your browser
items.desc: A free fireworks simulator — pick your shells, set the rhythm, light up your own night sky.

items.title: Read Wanzai through local voices
items.desc: Fiction and essays by local authors — free to read, with new chapters on the way.

cta.title: Start your Wanzai journey
cta.desc: Millennium fireworks culture, distinctive cuisine or natural scenery — Wanzai has something for you.

merchants.title: Whizzzest Picks
merchants.desc: The Wanzai guide trusted by travelers and locals alike — eat well, sleep well, bring Wanzai home.

cats.title: Authentic food
cats.desc: Six Bowls, rice noodles, lily banquets — the flavors of the fireworks hometown.

cats.title: Comfortable stays
cats.desc: Ancient-town guesthouses and county hotels — rest easy after the fireworks.

cats.title: Local specialties
cats.desc: Fireworks crafts, lily starch, sour-jujube cakes — take Wanzai home with you.
